name: Micias
bio: Micias is known only as the name under which a single epigram, on a wayside fountain, is preserved in the Greek Anthology. Nothing secure is recorded of his life, and his date is uncertain.
This archive carries one poem ascribed to him, in Sir Rennell Rodd's 1916 rendering from the Greek Anthology.

poems.title: A Wayside Fountain
poems.author: Micias
poems.text:
Rest here beneath the poplars,
  When tired with travelling,
And drawing nigh refresh you
  With water from our spring.
So may you keep in memory
  When under other skies
The fount his father Simus set
  By the grave where Gillus lies.
